product_summary: NTPC Limited (CIN L40101DL1975GOI007966, per ntpc.co.in footer) is India's largest integrated power utility: 91,668 MW installed capacity, ~24% share of all-India generation, with coal stations, gas stations, hydro stations, renewable (solar/wind) assets, coal mines, energy storage, plus green hydrogen, waste-to-energy and nuclear ambitions (ntpc.co.in home page, 'Our Energy Assets' blocks: Coal Stations, Coal Mines, Energy Storage, Gas Stations, Hydro Stations, Renewable Energy). The batch names are not separate companies but NTPC stations/projects/regional HQs and one subsidiary: Singrauli STPP, Rihand STPP, Vindhyachal STPS, Talcher STPP, Barh STPP, Khargone STPP, Gadarwara STPP, North Karanpura STPP, Badarpur TPS, Faridabad Gas Power Project, Ramam/Lata Tapovan hydro, Ganeshpura Solar PV, Dulanga and Talaipalli coal mining projects, Barwadih/Kerendari/Chatti Bariatu coal blocks, WR-II HQ, Port Blair, and NTPC Vidyut Vyapar Nigam Ltd (NVVN, the trading arm). Real output lines: (1) electricity — bulk generation and sale to discoms; (2) coal — mined from captive blocks (Dulanga, Talaipalli, Pakri Barwadih, Kerendari, Chatti Bariatu) and used captively, with surplus coal sold; (3) fly ash / ash products and gypsum from FGD; (4) power trading via NVVN; (5) EPC/consultancy services; (6) emerging: green hydrogen/ammonia, battery storage.
role_hint: manufacturer (captive generator/producer of electricity, coal, ash by-products) + trader via subsidiary NVVN; not a merchant exporter of goods
comment: HS 2716 'Electrical energy' is the correct heading for the core product — electricity is classified in 2716 00 (there is no 6-digit subdivision beyond 271600). So the declared code is substantively RIGHT for the main line, but it is only a partial description of the entity: NTPC also produces coal (2701 — lignite 2702 if applicable; mined coal from Dulanga/Talaipalli/Pakri Barwadih is bituminous, 2701.12/2701.19), fly ash (2621 or 6810/2523 depending on form; unprocessed ash is generally 2621.90), FGD gypsum (2520.10/2520.20), and trades electricity through NVVN (still 2716). Industry label 'Энергетика' is correct and not a misclassification. Trader signs: the batch mixes a genuine trading subsidiary (NTPC Vidyut Vyapar Nigam Ltd) with generating stations — these are distinct legal entities/units and should not be merged into one supplier record; 'Cinema Club' in the name list is clearly a data-entry artefact, not an NTPC entity. Product lines missing from the declaration: coal (2701), ash/gypsum by-products, and services (EPC/consultancy, which are not goods and have no HS code). Per project rule 3, no rejection on HS grounds — code retained as 2716 with the coal/by-product lines added. IMPORTANT: no customs/B-L line was available to me in this task (registry and customs-volume research is out of my scope), so the physical export of electricity or coal by NTPC is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — the product mapping above rests on the company's own website (ntpc.co.in) and is not corroborated by a shipment record. Note also that cross-border electricity sale is a regulated, contract-based flow rather than a normal customs line, so absence of a B-L is expected and not evidence of no supply.
